kinematic_model_classification.continuous_decay_model: Exponential Velocity Decay with Viscous Damping
kinematic_model_classification.framerate_invariance_mechanism: Because the exponent is scaled by elapsed frame delta (Delta_t in seconds), evaluating d^(1000 * Delta_t) ensures identical velocity decay over time regardless of whether CADisplayLink ticks at 60Hz (Delta_t = 16.67ms), 80Hz (Delta_t = 12.50ms), or 120Hz (Delta_t = 8.33ms)

normal.default_usage: Default scrolling deceleration rate for standard table views, collection views, and generic viewports

fast.default_usage: High-friction deceleration rate used for pagination carousels, photo galleries, and picker wheels

paging.default_usage: Internal deceleration rate applied by UIScrollViewPagingController when pagingEnabled == YES

per_frame_displacement_integral.formula: Delta_s = integral_0^(Delta_t) v(t) dt = (v_n / lambda) * (1 - e^(-lambda * Delta_t))
per_frame_displacement_integral.mathematical_equivalence: Because v_{n+1} = v_n * d^(1000 * Delta_t) = v_n * e^(-lambda * Delta_t), (v_n - v_{n+1}) / lambda exactly equals the continuous definite integral over [t_n, t_{n+1}], eliminating Euler truncation error

closed_form_landing_offset_prediction.formula: s_projected = s_0 + integral_0^infinity v(t) dt = s_0 + v_scroll / (-1000 * ln(d))
closed_form_landing_offset_prediction.derivation: integral_0^infinity v_0 * e^(-lambda * t) dt = [ -(v_0 / lambda) * e^(-lambda * t) ]_0^infinity = 0 - (-(v_0 / lambda)) = v_0 / lambda

terminal_actions: Set final contentOffset to presentationLayer position quantized to view scale grid

boundary_collision_detection.bouncing_enabled_action: Halt deceleration animation immediately, calculate fractional collision time t_collision, transfer residual kinetic momentum v_boundary to breached axes only in _UIScrollViewSpringAnimation, and enter elastic bounce recovery
boundary_collision_detection.bouncing_disabled_action: Clamp breached axes directly to boundary limits (minOffset / maxOffset), set colliding velocity components to 0.0, preserve perpendicular deceleration, and terminate animation if all velocity arrested
boundary_collision_detection.severe_hang_action: If dt > 0.500s (e.g. thread hang or app backgrounding), immediately cancel deceleration via _stopScrollingAndFillDisplayList: and dispatch scrollViewDidEndDecelerating:
boundary_collision_detection.cadisplaylink_integration: Stepped via CADisplayLink callback _UIScrollViewDecelerationDisplayLinkTick utilizing targetTimestamp for presentation-exact integration

decompiled_routines.role: Evaluates per-frame exponential velocity decay: v_{n+1} = v_n * d^(1000 * dt)
Calculates projected rest position: s_proj = s0 + v / (-1000 * ln(d))
Snaps projected landing offset to nearest page boundary detent
